mostWorthwhile.text: Making the tile was worthwhile because the explanation connected the planks to shaping clay and described how firing hardened it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the bowl at the kiln yard felt like a routine preparation, though it enabled glazing.

surprise.text: I expected glazing and firing might be separate, so the fired glazed bowl surprised me.

arbitrary.text: Combining clay with the formed bowl to make a jar lacked a clear physical connection for me.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see more material-making explanations, especially ones like the glaze and tile descriptions.
